title: ExpectationGenerateInput
description: Input for POST /api/v1/interviews/{interview_id}/expectation. The endpoint takes no body; it reads the interview record from the database. This schema describes the interview fields that drive expectation generation.

job_title.description: Job title used in the expectation header and guidance.

jd.description: Full job description text. The agent extracts implied skills and responsibilities from here.

skills_required.description: Every skill in this list MUST appear in the output's mandatory_skills or optional_skills.

experience_level.description: Drives interview type, phase durations, and resume-probing rules.

company_type.description: Drives interview type and interviewer guidance.

duration_minutes.description: Total interview duration. The output's structure durations must sum to this.
